documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported a 53.3% YoY increase in revenue from operations for Q1 FY27 to ₹472.2 crores, up from ₹307.9 crores in Q1 FY26. EBITDA for the quarter grew 44.5% YoY to ₹92.3 crores with margins at 19.2%. The company is executing an ongoing capex of ~₹200 crore funded via internal accruals for debottlenecking, expanding its ABS capacity from 75,000 MTPA to 100,000 MTPA by 30th September 2026. Optimal utilisation of the expanded capacity is anticipated by the end of FY28. Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported revenue from operations of INR 1,276.0 crores and EBITDA of INR 255.2 crores for FY26.

guidance.claim: Management expects optimal utilisation of the expanded capacity by the end of FY28.
guidance.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

guidance.claim: The company expects to complete the commissioning of its enhanced ABS capacity by the end of September 2026.
guidance.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

demand_outlook.claim: Appliances and automotive continue to dominate global demand for ABS resins.
demand_outlook.quote: Appliances and Automotive continue to dominate global demand for ABS resins due to their high impact resistance and aesthetic versatility.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth in consumer durables and automotive sectors is expected to drive domestic ABS demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Robust growth in end-user industries like consumer durables (air conditioners, refrigerators) and automotive will drive the domestic demand for ABS.

demand_outlook.claim: The global market is transitioning toward higher-margin specialty and colored ABS grades.
demand_outlook.quote: The global market is shifting toward specialty & colored grades, moving away from commoditized transparent resins to higher-margin applications.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that domestic ABS consumption significantly exceeds local production, offering substantial scope for growth.
demand_outlook.quote: There is immense scope for growth, considering the existing supply and demand mismatch, and knowing the fact that the consumption of ABS in India is voluminously larger as compared to the combined output of the domestic manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: The company sees a positive long-term outlook for engineering thermoplastics used in household appliances.
demand_outlook.quote: Accordingly, the long-term outlook for engineering thermoplastics used in household appliances remains positive.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's expansion of ABS capacity from 75,000 TPA to 100,000 TPA is progressing, with orders placed for critical long-delivery equipment.
capex_expansion.quote: The implementation of capacity expansion from existing 75000 TPA to 1,00,000 TPA is progressing well and orders have been placed for critical long delivery equipments.

capex_expansion.claim: Commissioning of the expanded capacity is scheduled for completion by the end of September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 increased by 44.5% YoY to ₹92.3 crores, with EBITDA margin at 19.2%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 44.5% YoY in Q1 FY27 to ₹ 92.3 crores, from ₹ 63.9 crores in Q1 FY26, with margins at 19.2% for Q1 FY27 as compared to 20.0% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q4 FY26 grew 33.1% YoY to INR 74.3 crores with a margin of 21.8%, while FY26 EBITDA reached INR 255.2 crores with a 20.0% margin.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 33.1% YoY in Q4 FY26 to INR 74.3 crores, with margins at 21.8%; for FY26, EBITDA grew by 1.3% to INR 255.2 crores, with margins at 20.0%.

margins_costs.claim: The company recorded an operating margin of 19.42% and a net profit margin of 14.14% for FY 2025-26.
margins_costs.quote: The operating margin for FY 2025-26 was 19.42 % as compared to 17.43 % for FY 2024-25, whereas the net profit margin stood at 14.14 % as compared to 12.86 % for the previous FY.

margins_costs.claim: Domestic ABS producers deliberately maintain low inventories of imported key raw materials, which comprise over 85% of composition, to limit price volatility risk.
margins_costs.quote: The limitation arises out of deliberate decision on the part of domestic manufacturers to keep low inventories of its imported key raw materials which is more than 85% (i.e. Styrene and Acrylonitrile monomers) to limit the risk of price fluctuations which may result in huge loss, if the price of monomers drastically falls in the international market, which happen many a times due to unpredictable reasons, i.e. fluctuation in price of crude oil, benzene and ethylene.

orders_capacity.claim: In FY 2025-26, the company produced 71,601.50 TPA against an installed capacity of 75,000 TPA.
orders_capacity.quote: During FY 2025-26, the Company achieved production volume of 71601 TPA against installed capacity of 75,000 TPA.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volume for FY 2025-26 stood at 71,501 TPA compared to 74,381 TPA in FY 2024-25.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume stood at 71501 TPA (Previous year - 74381 TPA).

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a debt-free balance sheet with zero financial risk.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt-free balance sheet ensures zero financial risk and high resilience.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a disciplined capital allocation with an average dividend payout ratio of over 50%.
capital_allocation.quote: Healthy dividend payout (~50%+)* reflects disciplined capital allocation and shareholder returns.

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared three interim dividends of Re. 1 per share each and recommended a final dividend of Re. 1 per share for FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: Continuing with the practice of rewarding shareholders, the Board declared three Interim Dividends, each of Re.1/- (collectively 300%) per Equity shares of Re.1/- and recommended a Final Dividend of Re.1/- (100 %) per Equity Share for the Financial Year Ended 31st March, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintained its status as a zero-debt entity.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company continues to enjoy the status of a “Zero Debt Company”.

capital_allocation.claim: Operations will continue to be sustained through internal accruals with no changes to the financing pattern.
capital_allocation.quote: There was no change in financing pattern and the Company would be able to sustain its business operations through internal accruals.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ABS business in India is vulnerable to foreign exchange fluctuations because primary raw materials like Styrene and Acrylonitrile are entirely imported.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ABS business in India is exposed to the risk of foreign exchange fluctuations, as the key raw materials viz. ‘Styrene’ and ‘Acrylonitrile’ are import dependent, as there is no indigenous producer for these monomers.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted a darkening global economic outlook caused by war in the Middle East.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global outlook has abruptly darkened following the outbreak of war in the Middle East on February 28, 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects optimal utilisation of the expanded capacity by the end of FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to complete the commissioning of its enhanced ABS capacity of 100,000 TPA by the end of September 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
